headline: Iran warns of full-scale offensive operations if US attacks continue
summary: Mohsen Rezaee, advisor to the Supreme Leader, warns Tehran will shift from defensive to offensive warfare if US strikes persist.
details: Mohsen Rezaee, an advisor to Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has warned that Iran will launch 'full-scale offensive operations' if US attacks continue for a few more days.
In an interview with state television on Friday, July 17, Rezaee stated that Tehran would move beyond its current position if the US persists in its strikes.
He further emphasized that Iran will not remain in a purely defensive posture if the US attempts to occupy any part of Iranian territory.
Rezaee's warnings come amid rising military tensions between the US and Iran, with both sides engaging in retaliatory strikes.
The ongoing conflict has raised significant concerns about the wider escalation of conflict across the Middle East.

headline: 784 children die from measles symptoms nationwide
summary: Four more children died in the last 24 hours, bringing the total death toll to 784 since March 15, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Four children died with measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Saturday.
